text: I'm mouthwash, 'cause if I was on the floor, I'd swish (Fluoride, fluoride, swish)
source: The Adventures of Moon Man & Slim Shady
album: The Adventures of Moon Man & Slim Shady

meta.title: The Adventures of Moon Man & Slim Shady

body: Em plays with “floor, I’d” in order to produce a homophone to the word “fluoride.” This ties into his basketball prowess of scoring “swishes”—which is a flawless shot—while also doubling to the swishing movement when using mouthwash.
Em used similar lyrics in 2005’s track “Shake That,” using a different concept:
Open your mouth for about four or five minutes
